facts.fact: We Are Tech says the High Commissioner for Digitalisation unveiled the National Digital Transformation Strategy (SNTN) on Monday 12 May 2025 as a blueprint to digitise Algeria by 2030, with the President's backing but no adopting act named.

The strategy sets targets for 2030: training 500,000 ICT specialists, cutting their emigration by 40%, a 20% GDP share for the digital sector, and complete digitisation of government administration; no cost is stated.
The strategy targets the year 2030 and the article does not say the full text is public.

note: The strategy covers five pillars: infrastructure, skills, digital governance, digital economy and digital society, so it spans the economy and the state.
